public_balance_sheet_register.exposure_name: FHA insurance, GSE conservatorship/Treasury support, and federal housing-finance guarantee surface
public_balance_sheet_register.legal_authority: National Housing Act/FHA MMI Fund, FHFA conservatorship authority, Treasury senior preferred stock purchase agreements, federal credit-program accounting, GSE charter/governance authorities
public_balance_sheet_register.claimant_perimeter: First-time and lower-wealth borrowers, renters priced out by capitalization, FHA/GSE borrowers, lenders, servicers, MBS investors, taxpayers, Treasury, future buyers

indirect: renters facing asset-price support without access

public_balance_sheet_register.maximum_exposure: FHA insurance-in-force, GSE mortgage guarantees/MBS support, Treasury support commitments, and correlated housing-market stress exposure.
public_balance_sheet_register.expected_loss: Reported credit-subsidy/capital position under baseline plus correlated downside risk; loss visibility depends on accounting method, capital assumptions, and stress correlations.
public_balance_sheet_register.stress_scenario: Housing downturn or affordability shock raises defaults and guarantee claims while support value may have already capitalized into prices, lender volumes, servicer fees, or investor yields.
public_balance_sheet_register.funding_source: Insurance premiums, guarantee fees, capital buffers, Treasury support, credit-risk transfer, borrower payments, and future taxpayer/market support.
public_balance_sheet_register.loss_sharing: Borrowers and taxpayers should not be residual claimants after intermediaries/investors capture upside; guarantee fees, capital, CRT, servicer duties, and Treasury terms must allocate losses explicitly.
public_balance_sheet_register.public_upside_recovery: Guarantee fees, capital buffers, Treasury dividends/warrants, affordability conditions, loss mitigation, credit-risk transfer with real risk transfer, and recapture if public support raises private returns.
public_balance_sheet_register.ordinary_claimant_protection: Protect access, sustainable affordability, loss mitigation, and anti-displacement before investor yield, price capitalization, or intermediary margins.
public_balance_sheet_register.sunset_or_review: Annual FHA/GSE/Federal credit-program refresh; immediate review after conservatorship or Treasury-support change.
